```{python}
import json

# -------------------------------------------------------------------

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent
DATA = ROOT / "data"

with open(DATA / "profile.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    profile = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "education.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    education = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "employment.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    employment = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "grants.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    grants = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "teaching.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    teaching = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "supervision.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    supervision = yaml.safe_load(f)

with open(DATA / "publications.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    publications = json.load(f)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Publication categories
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

journal_articles = [
    p for p in publications
    if p.get("category") == "Journal article"
]

book_chapters = [
    p for p in publications
    if p.get("category") == "Book chapter"
]

conference_presentations = [
    p for p in publications
    if p.get("category") == "Conference presentation"
]

invited_talks = [
    p for p in conference_presentations
    if p.get("presentation_type") == "Invited talk"
]

oral_presentations = [
    p for p in conference_presentations
    if p.get("presentation_type") == "Oral presentation"
]

posters = [
    p for p in conference_presentations
    if p.get("presentation_type") == "Poster"
]

reports = [
    p for p in publications
    if p.get("category") == "Report"
]

other_contributions = [
    p for p in publications
    if p.get("category") == "Other scientific contribution"
]


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Formatting functions
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

def format_country(code):
    """Convert HAL country codes to readable country names."""

    countries = {
        "fr": "France",
        "ca": "Canada",
        "gb": "United Kingdom",
        "uk": "United Kingdom",
        "us": "United States",
        "de": "Germany",
        "es": "Spain",
        "it": "Italy",
        "be": "Belgium",
        "nl": "Netherlands",
        "ch": "Switzerland",
        "gr": "Greece",
        "cy": "Cyprus",
        "au": "Australia",
        "jp": "Japan",
        "cn": "China",
        "se": "Sweden",
        "dk": "Denmark",
        "fi": "Finland",
        "no": "Norway",
        "pt": "Portugal",
    }

    if not code:
        return None

    return countries.get(code.lower(), code.upper())


def format_date(date_string):
    """Format YYYY-MM-DD as '19 November 2025'."""

    if not date_string:
        return None

    try:
        date = datetime.strptime(date_string, "%Y-%m-%d")
        return date.strftime("%-d %B %Y")
    except ValueError:
        return date_string


def format_conference_dates(pub):
    """Format conference start/end dates."""

    start = pub.get("conference_start")
    end = pub.get("conference_end")

    if not start:
        return None

    if not end or start == end:
        return format_date(start)

    try:
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start, "%Y-%m-%d")
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end, "%Y-%m-%d")

        if start_date.year == end_date.year:
            if start_date.month == end_date.month:
                return (
                    f"{start_date.day}–{end_date.day} "
                    f"{start_date.strftime('%B %Y')}"
                )
            else:
                return (
                    f"{start_date.day} {start_date.strftime('%B')}–"
                    f"{end_date.day} {end_date.strftime('%B %Y')}"
                )

        return f"{format_date(start)}–{format_date(end)}"

    except ValueError:
        return f"{start}–{end}"


def is_scott(author):
    """Return True if an author is Scott A. Love."""

    return author.strip().lower() in {
        "scott love",
        "scott a. love",
        "scott a love",
    }


def abbreviate_author(author):
    """
    Convert a full author name to surname + initials.

    Examples:
        Katherine L Bryant -> Bryant KL
        Arnaud Le Troter -> Le Troter A
        Scott A. Love -> Scott A. Love
    """

    author = author.strip()

    if is_scott(author):
        return author

    parts = author.split()

    if len(parts) < 2:
        return author

    # Handle common multi-word surnames such as:
    # Le Troter, De Silva, Van der Meer, etc.
    surname_particles = {
        "de",
        "da",
        "del",
        "della",
        "di",
        "du",
        "des",
        "le",
        "la",
        "van",
        "von",
        "der",
        "den",
        "ter",
        "ten",
    }

    surname_start = len(parts) - 1

    while (
        surname_start > 0
        and parts[surname_start - 1].lower() in surname_particles
    ):
        surname_start -= 1

    surname = " ".join(parts[surname_start:])
    given_names = parts[:surname_start]

    initials = "".join(
        p[0].upper()
        for p in given_names
        if p and p[0].isalpha()
    )

    return f"{surname} {initials}"


def format_authors(authors):
    """Format authors with Scott A. Love highlighted."""

    formatted = []

    for author in authors:

        if is_scott(author):
            formatted.append(f"**{author}**")
        else:
            formatted.append(author)

    return ", ".join(formatted)


def format_author_list(authors, max_authors=6):
    """
    Format authors for publications.

    Authors are abbreviated except for Scott A. Love.
    Long author lists are shortened with 'et al.'.
    """

    formatted = []

    for author in authors:

        if is_scott(author):
            formatted.append(f"**{author}**")
        else:
            formatted.append(
                abbreviate_author(author)
            )

    if len(formatted) > max_authors:

        visible = formatted[:max_authors]

        # Make sure Scott remains visible if he is not
        # among the first max_authors.
        if any("**Scott" in author for author in formatted):
            if not any("**Scott" in author for author in visible):
                visible[-1] = "**Scott A. Love**"

        return ", ".join(visible) + ", et al."

    return ", ".join(formatted)


def link(url, text):
    """Create a Markdown link if a URL exists."""

    if not url:
        return ""

    return f"[{text}]({url})"


def publication_year(pub):
    """Return publication year as an integer."""

    return pub.get("year") or 0


def sort_publications(items):
    """Sort publications from newest to oldest."""

    return sorted(
        items,
        key=publication_year,
        reverse=True,
    )


def format_reference(pub):
    """Create a formatted journal/book reference."""

    authors = format_author_list(pub["authors"])

    reference = (
        f"{authors} "
        f"({pub['year']}). "
        f"*{pub['title']}*."
    )

    if pub.get("journal"):
        reference += (
            f" **{pub['journal']}**."
        )

    if pub.get("publisher"):
        reference += (
            f" {pub['publisher']}."
        )

    if pub.get("doi"):
        reference += (
            f" [doi:{pub['doi']}]"
            f"(https://doi.org/{pub['doi']})"
        )

    return reference


def format_conference_reference(pub, presentation_type):
    """
    Format conference presentations.

    Uses abbreviated author names and highlights Scott A. Love.

    Example:
    Bryant KL, Meunier D, Scott A. Love, et al. (2025).
    Title. Invited talk, Conference name, date, location.
    """

    authors = format_author_list(pub["authors"])

    text = (
        f"- {authors} "
        f"({pub['year']}). "
        f"*{pub['title']}*. "
        f"{presentation_type}, "
    )

    details = []

    if pub.get("conference"):

        conference = pub["conference"]

        if pub.get("conference_url"):
            conference = link(
                pub["conference_url"],
                conference
            )

        details.append(
            f"*{conference}*"
        )

    dates = format_conference_dates(pub)

    if dates:
        details.append(dates)

    location = ", ".join(
        x for x in [
            pub.get("city"),
            format_country(pub.get("country"))
        ]
        if x
    )

    if location:
        details.append(location)

    text += ", ".join(details) + "."

    return text
```

## Employment

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

def format_employment_date(value):
    """Format employment dates for display."""

    if not value:
        return ""

    value = str(value)

    if value.lower() == "present":
        return "present"

    # Handle YYYY-MM
    if len(value) == 7 and value[4] == "-":
        year, month = value.split("-")

        months = {
            "01": "January",
            "02": "February",
            "03": "March",
            "04": "April",
            "05": "May",
            "06": "June",
            "07": "July",
            "08": "August",
            "09": "September",
            "10": "October",
            "11": "November",
            "12": "December",
        }

        return f"{months.get(month, month)} {year}"

    return value


for position in employment:

    start = format_employment_date(position.get("start"))
    end = format_employment_date(position.get("end"))

    if start and end:
        dates = f"{start}–{end}"
    else:
        dates = start or end

    institution = position["institution"]

    if position.get("country"):
        institution += f", {position['country']}"

    print(
        f"**{dates}**  \n"
        f"**{position['position']}**, {institution}  \n"
    )

    if position.get("supervisor"):
        print(
            f"Supervisor: {position['supervisor']}  \n"
        )

    if position.get("team"):
        print(
            f"Team: {position['team']}  \n"
        )

    print()
```

## Grants

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

with open(DATA / "grants.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    grants = yaml.safe_load(f)

for grant in grants:

    # Date range
    dates = f"{grant['start']}–{grant['end']}"

    # Main entry
    title = grant["title"]

    if grant.get("acronym"):
        title += f" ({grant['acronym']})"

    print(
        f"**{dates}**  \n"
        f"**{grant['funder']}** — {title}"
    )

    print()

    # Funding amount and role
    details = []

    if grant.get("amount"):
        details.append(grant["amount"])

    if grant.get("role"):
        details.append(f"Role: {grant['role']}")

    if details:
        print(", ".join(details))

    # Description
    if grant.get("description"):
        print(f"  \n{grant['description']}")

    # Partners (optional)
    if grant.get("partners"):
        print(
            "  \nPartners: " +
            ", ".join(grant["partners"])
        )

    print()
```
